digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Plan-review criteria rubrics conflate 'Success Criteria' and 'Acceptance Criteria' vocabulary, suggesting a distinction that is not implemented and creating noise in the generated criteria guide.
Dual terminology 'acceptance/success criterion' appears across reviewer prompts (F1, G3, G5, G7, COH, container, completion_verifier) and routing index, causing pooled application of a single bar.
Renaming Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria throughout reviewer prompts and criteria routing index will normalize the vocabulary at source and eliminate noise from the criteria guide.
The generated criteria guide (docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md) must be regenerated after the source changes to reflect the normalized terminology.

Editing criteria_routing.json rotates the registry version stamp, invalidating outstanding attestations, but this is safe because prerequisite ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053) has merged and grandfathers the drift.
